package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/config"
	pgadapter "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/diagnosticfixture"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

const (
	migrateFreshCommand                         = "migrate-fresh"
	provisionDiagnosticAssessmentFixtureCommand = "provision-diagnostic-assessment-fixture"
	defaultMigrationsDirectory                  = "db/migrations"
)

var v2FixtureRunIDPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$`)

type diagnosticFixtureFailure struct {
	Schema string `json:"schema"`
	Status string `json:"status"`
	Reason string `json:"reason"`
}

func runFreshMigrationsCommand(ctx context.Context) int {
	cfg, err := config.Load()
	if err != nil {
		return writeMigrationResult(pgadapter.FreshMigrationResult{Schema: pgadapter.FreshMigrationResultSchema, Status: "failed", Reason: "invalid_configuration"})
	}
	pool, err := pgadapter.Connect(ctx, cfg.DatabaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		return writeMigrationResult(pgadapter.FreshMigrationResult{Schema: pgadapter.FreshMigrationResultSchema, Status: "failed", Reason: "database_unavailable"})
	}
	defer pool.Close()

	directory := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("COURSE_MIGRATIONS_DIR"))
	if directory == "" {
		directory = defaultMigrationsDirectory
	}
	result, runErr := pgadapter.RunFreshMigrations(ctx, pool, os.DirFS(filepath.Clean(directory)))
	if runErr != nil {
		return writeMigrationResult(result)
	}
	return writeMigrationResult(result)
}

func runDiagnosticAssessmentFixtureCommand(ctx context.Context) int {
	cfg, err := config.Load()
	if err != nil {
		return writeDiagnosticFixtureFailure("invalid_configuration")
	}
	pool, err := pgadapter.Connect(ctx, cfg.DatabaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		return writeDiagnosticFixtureFailure("database_unavailable")
	}
	defer pool.Close()

	if err := validateV2FixtureTarget(ctx, pool); err != nil {
		return writeDiagnosticFixtureFailure("target_guard_rejected")
	}
	definition, err := diagnosticfixture.LoadDefinition()
	if err != nil {
		return writeDiagnosticFixtureFailure("fixture_contract_invalid")
	}
	provisioner := diagnosticfixture.Provisioner{
		Definition: definition,
		Dependencies: diagnosticfixture.Dependencies{
			Tx:              pgadapter.TxManagerPG{Pool: pool},
			Courses:         pgadapter.CourseRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			CourseI18n:      pgadapter.CourseI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			I18n:            pgadapter.I18nRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			CodeStructures:  pgadapter.CodeStructureTypeRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			Modules:         pgadapter.ModuleRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			ModuleI18n:      pgadapter.ModuleI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			CourseModules:   pgadapter.CourseModuleRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			Sections:        pgadapter.SectionRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			SectionI18n:     pgadapter.SectionI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			ModuleSections:  pgadapter.ModuleSectionRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			Lessons:         pgadapter.LessonRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			LessonI18n:      pgadapter.LessonI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			SectionLessons:  pgadapter.SectionLessonRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			Tasks:           pgadapter.TaskRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			TaskI18n:        pgadapter.TaskI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			TaskTests:       pgadapter.TaskTestRepoPG{Pool: pool},
			LearningTargets: pgadapter.TaskLearningTargetRepoPG{Pool: pool},
		},
	}
	result, err := provisioner.Ensure(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, diagnosticfixture.ErrDrift) {
			// The returned CLI payload stays deliberately coarse and safe. The
			// owner log keeps the static contract path so operators can resolve
			// a fixture drift without exposing questions, variants, or answers.
			log.Printf("diagnostic assessment fixture drift: %v", err)
			return writeDiagnosticFixtureFailure("fixture_drift")
		}
		// Keep the machine-readable payload coarse while preserving an
		// operator-actionable, content-free failure chain in the owner log.
		log.Printf("diagnostic assessment fixture provisioning failed: %v", err)
		return writeDiagnosticFixtureFailure("provisioning_failed")
	}
	if err := writeJSON(result); err != nil {
		return 2
	}
	return 0
}

func validateV2FixtureTarget(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
	runID := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("LW_V2_COURSE_FIXTURE_RUN_ID"))
	targetDatabase := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("LW_V2_COURSE_FIXTURE_TARGET_DATABASE"))
	if !v2FixtureRunIDPattern.MatchString(runID) || targetDatabase == "" {
		return errors.New("missing or invalid V2 fixture target guard")
	}
	var connectedDatabase string
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT current_database()`).Scan(&connectedDatabase); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("prove V2 fixture target database: %w", err)
	}
	if connectedDatabase != targetDatabase {
		return errors.New("V2 fixture target database does not match connected database")
	}
	return nil
}

func writeMigrationResult(result pgadapter.FreshMigrationResult) int {
	if err := writeJSON(result); err != nil {
		return 2
	}
	if result.Status != "applied" {
		return 2
	}
	return 0
}

func writeDiagnosticFixtureFailure(reason string) int {
	if err := writeJSON(diagnosticFixtureFailure{Schema: "course-diagnostic-assessment-fixture-result.v1", Status: "failed", Reason: reason}); err != nil {
		return 2
	}
	return 2
}

func writeJSON(value any) error {
	return json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(value)
}
